title: Cornell students and faculty protest university's handling of sexual violence allegations
seoTitle: Ithaca rally over Cornell sexual violence

tea.why: Protesters are demonstrating against Cornell University's and police's handling of alleged gang rape and other sexual violence cases on campus.
tea.want: Students demand the Cornell president's resignation, an external inquiry, independent hearings, and uniform sanctions for sexual assaults.
tea.changed: Oct 5: Hundreds of students and faculty protested at Cornell University, calling for the president's resignation and policy changes.

summary: On October 5, hundreds of students, faculty members, and members of the public gathered at Cornell University in Ithaca, New York. The protest addressed the university's and police's handling of an alleged gang rape in October 2024 and other sexual violence cases on campus. Demonstrators called for the resignation of Cornell President Michael Kotlikoff and other administrators, an external inquiry into the university's response, and independent hearings. They also demanded uniform minimum sanctions for all sexual assaults, improved training for campus police, and the expulsion or revocation of degrees for students found complicit in the alleged gang rape. Cornell University has stated it defended its response to the original report, shut down the Chi Phi chapter, and imposed discipline on fraternity members.

response: Cornell University has defended its response to the original report, stating it shut down the Chi Phi chapter and imposed various disciplinary actions, including expulsions and other sanctions, on the fraternity members involved.
